block.goal: Extract compaction plugin configuration, selector execution, and compaction helper coordination into a cohesive class, reducing the general-purpose method count and implementation complexity of CompactableUtils.

ops.details: Move the compaction selector and configurer methods, newInstance, getHelper, getOverrides, and both private CompactionHelper implementations together. Preserve package visibility for package-private methods and preserve the existing nested helper behavior. Update references from CompactableUtils.newInstance, CompactableUtils.selectFiles, and computeOverrides to the extracted class within the moved implementation.

Add all imports required by the extracted compaction plugin implementation, including plugin, compaction, summary, configuration, metadata, and Hadoop types. Remove imports from CompactableUtils that are no longer referenced after extraction.

Update CompactableImpl and any other callers to use CompactableCompactionUtils. In CompactableUtils.compact, replace the call to getOverrides with CompactableCompactionUtils.getOverrides. Preserve method signatures and package-level accessibility.
